title: Soham Parekh Broke Every Rule of Overemployment
description:
I'm late on the news. Soham Parekh got caught with his hand deep in the Overemployed cookie jar. 

Many people are using it as a case study AGAINST overemployment. I say, Soham just showed us exactly what NOT to do. Let's dig into what we can learn. 

Also, Im thinking about building a community.  These are my ideas so far. 
-15 minute onboarding call with me
-Monthly Q&A
-Exclusive Videos (Desk setup, Resume Reviews etc.)
-Toe pictures?
-Weekly Newsletter

What could I add to it that would be helpful?
